PUMP (2007) by DAVID ADEY. David Adey transforms an ordinary football into a strange kinetic sculpture. Its surface is densely covered with drywall screws, while a hidden respirator repeatedly inflates and deflates the ball, producing a slow, mechanical rhythm. Created in 2007, Pump was later included in the 2010 California Biennial at the Orange County Museum of Art. #art #avantgarde #niche #artist #weird

artist Jakob Grosse-Ophoff creates playful kinetic sculptures that transform simple human gestures into mechanical movements. Working with wood, metal, motors and carefully constructed mechanisms.
